title: Movie Night Board
h1: Movie Night Charcuterie Board for Two
seo_title: Movie Night Charcuterie Board for Two: Sweet & Salty Plan
description: A movie night charcuterie board for two: sharp white cheddar, pepper jack, pepperoni, salami, butter popcorn, chocolate-covered pretzels and mini peanut butter cups.
hook: Sweet, salty and made for the couch: everything on it can be eaten in the dark with one hand.
why: Movie night food has to work without looking: cubes of sharp white cheddar and pepper jack, pepperoni and salami, and bowls of popcorn and pretzel crisps. Nothing needs a knife or a second hand.
The sweet half (chocolate-covered pretzels, mini peanut butter cups, red grapes) sits against the salty half, so you keep going back and forth. A crisp lager or a fruity Lambrusco works with both.

timeline.what: Take out the meats; pick the movie.
Pop the popcorn; build the board.

faq.q: What goes on a movie night charcuterie board?
faq.a: Cubed cheddar and pepper jack, pepperoni and salami, popcorn, chocolate-covered pretzels, mini peanut butter cups, grapes, honey-roasted peanuts and pretzel crisps.

faq.q: How do you keep the popcorn crisp?
faq.a: Serve it in its own bowl on the board, away from the grapes and cheese, and add it last.
A crisp lager or a slightly sparkling red like Lambrusco. Both handle salty and sweet snacks.
